title: False positive: /reports/status interpolates only allowlisted constant values
evidence: demo-store-api/app/main.py:28 reads the user-controlled `status` param into `key`. main.py:29 maps it through the REPORT_STATUSES dict (lines 8-12) with `.get(key, "OPEN")`, so `status` can only be one of the hardcoded constants "OPEN", "SHIPPED" or "REFUNDED". User input never reaches the f-string at main.py:31. Separately, the route has no authentication even though its docstring (line 27) says it is for the operations dashboard. That exposes aggregate order counts, but it is not SQL injection.
recommended_fix: No injection fix is required. For defense in depth and to quiet the scanner, switch to a parameterized query: conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = ?", (status,)). Separately, check whether this internal dashboard endpoint should require authentication.
